comment: Static knowledge for components that no package metadata describes. Presence of a text is not a clearance; 'unverified' strings are shown in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. Keys: <purltype>:<normalised name>[@version].

pypi:certifi.note: MPL-2.0. The wheel's LICENSE file is only the MPL notice header ('If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this file...'); the full MPL-2.0 text is added from mozilla.org. cacert.pem (the Mozilla CA list) is its own source form; MPL-2.0 section 3.2 (Executable Form) handling is an owner/counsel decision.

pypi:cryptography.note: The wheel statically links OpenSSL 4.0.2 and 39 Rust crates; see the generic OpenSSL entry and its own SBOM inside the wheel.

pypi:knowledge-frontier.missing_reason: tag v0.1.0 has no LICENSE file; the LICENSE added on 2026-10-13 (commit d32a82af) is marked 'LICENSE INTENT INFERRED - owner to confirm'

pypi:redevops-connectors.declared: AGPL-3.0-or-later (pyproject at tag v0.1.0); later main declares the family licence
pypi:redevops-connectors.missing_reason: tag v0.1.0 has no LICENSE file; the family-licence files added on 2026-10-13 (commit d990280a) are marked 'LICENSE INTENT INFERRED - owner to confirm'

pypi:runtime-contracts.note: Family licence (AGPL-3.0-or-later with the Commons Clause) per its own LICENSE.md.

pypi:duckdb.note: Optional extra backend, included in the sidecar build (extras projects,duckdb). The wheel statically links third-party libraries whose notices are not separately listed.

pypi:pyyaml.note: The compiled _yaml extension embeds libyaml; its notice is covered by the generic libyaml entry.

pypi:pydantic-core.note: Embeds Rust crates; their notices are not separately listed (see decision D-LIC-6).

cargo:selectors.unverified: The crate package holds no licence file; the generic MPL-2.0 text is shown, without the crate's copyright notice. File-level copyleft (MPL-2.0 section 3.2) handling is as for certifi (D-LIC-4).

npm:react.note: MIT licence text of the React 18.3.1 repository (the same text for react, react-dom and scheduler); the vendored UI bundle carries the licence banners only.

npm:react-dom.note: MIT licence text of the React 18.3.1 repository (the same text for react, react-dom and scheduler); the vendored UI bundle carries the licence banners only.

npm:scheduler.note: MIT licence text of the React 18.3.1 repository (the same text for react, react-dom and scheduler); the vendored UI bundle carries the licence banners only.

key:certifi-bundle.note: Mozilla CA certificate bundle (cacert.pem) inside certifi, MPL-2.0. The text shown is the full MPL-2.0; the certifi wheel's own LICENSE (an MPL notice header) is listed under the certifi component.

key:pyinstaller-runtime.note: PyInstaller COPYING.txt: GPL-2.0-or-later with the Bootloader Exception; runtime hooks Apache-2.0. Its bootloader and pyimod runtime are inside the sidecar executable.

key:launcher.not_third_party: first-party: the Agentic Apps launcher; its licence is the product licence (LICENSING.md). Its third-party crates are listed individually.

key:sidecar.not_third_party: first-party: the frozen sidecar executable; its contents are listed component by component.

key:ui-bundle.not_third_party: first-party: the vendored Projects UI bundle (agentic_os/projects_ui); the product licence applies (LICENSING.md); the React libraries inside it are listed as react / react-dom.

key:asset:agentic_os/projects_ui/hero.jp.not_third_party: first-party asset: the neutral generated placeholder that replaced the original image in R0-prime (scripts/make_neutral_hero.py); the provenance statement is owner decision D-LIC-8.

key:platform:wkwebview.not_third_party: system component of macOS (WKWebView / WebKit): linked as an operating-system library, not redistributed in the artifact.

key:licenses-folder.not_third_party: first-party: the Licenses folder itself (product licence files and these notices), embedded in the sidecar by the second freeze pass

cargo:r-efi.note: The crate package (and the upstream repository at the packaged commit db87f6c8, tag v5.2.0) holds no LICENSE file. The licence statement of the project is in its AUTHORS file, which is shown here verbatim: it says the project is triple-licensed (MIT, Apache-2.0, LGPL-2.1-or-later) and reproduces the MIT permission notice and the Apache-2.0 and LGPL-2.1+ notice headers, with the copyright lines of Red Hat, Microsoft and David Rheinsberg. The full Apache-2.0 and LGPL-2.1 texts are not part of the package. The crate is in the dependency graph of the Windows launcher build and in the macOS set as a transitive dependency; the choice among the three licences is the redistributor's (register item D-LIC-13).
cargo:r-efi.unverified: AUTHORS is the package's own file (sha256 recorded in notices-report.json) and was compared with AUTHORS at upstream commit db87f6c8 (identical); a licence statement in AUTHORS rather than in a LICENSE file is a fact about this crate, not a clearance.
